notes:
Grande Vitória Aquaviário (Ceturb-ES), catamarã ferry system relaunched Aug 2023 across Baía de Vitória. Three fixed terminals confirmed by multiple sources (semobi.es.gov.br, ceturb.es.gov.br/aquaviario, es.gov.br naming law, cariacica.es.gov.br): Estação Setembrino Pelissari (Praça do Papa, Vitória), Estação Gov. Albuíno Azeredo (Prainha, Vila Velha), Estação Prefeito Aloízio Santos (Porto de Santana, Cariacica). Three lines: 401 Porto de Santana<->Praça do Papa, 402 Praça do Papa<->Prainha, 403 Porto de Santana<->Prainha. route_type=4 (ferry).

SCHEDULE FIDELITY: Line 402 weekday departure times are taken VERBATIM from published Ceturb horarios (via search result quoting the interface): Praça do Papa dias úteis 6h25..19h05 (27 deps) and Prainha dias úteis 6h25..19h05 (27 deps). I included the full published weekday 402 departure lists as two direction trips-per-departure would exceed a representative feed, so I encoded a representative subset AND the head/tail plus mid-day departures faithfully; each departure = one trip. Line 403 weekend times taken VERBATIM: Porto de Santana Sáb 8h25,10h05,11h45,13h25,16h05,17h45 / Prainha Sáb 9h15,10h55,12h35,14h15,16h55; Porto de Santana Dom 10h15,11h55,13h35,15h15,16h55 / Prainha Dom 9h25,11h05,12h45,14h25,16h05. Line 401 exact per-departure times were NOT published in accessible sources (folhavitoria says ~14 weekday departures 06:15-20:15 approx hourly; a 2024 news item added 12 new weekday departures split 6+6). I therefore synthesised 401 weekday departures on an even ~hourly headway across 06:15-20:15 (marked as estimated), NOT verbatim.

CROSSING TIMES estimated from bay geometry: 402 Praça do Papa<->Prainha ~8 min; 401 Porto de Santana<->Praça do Papa ~22 min; 403 Porto de Santana<->Prainha ~28 min (Penedo boat routed under the Cinco Pontes).

COORDINATES: terminal piers geocoded manually from OSM/known landmark geography (WGS-84). Porto de Santana corroborated by nearby street coords (Rua Santo Antônio -20.3068,-40.3702). Praça do Papa and Prainha pier points approximate to the bay-edge terminal (±100-200m). Operating windows confirmed: Mon-Fri 06:00-20:00/20:30, Sat 08:00-18:00, Sun/holiday 09:00-15:00 (403 weekend-focused). Confidence 0.62: terminals/lines/402-weekday/403-weekend times are well-evidenced; 401 times and exact crossing durations are estimated.
